description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a ViewPager with tabs, using FragmentPagerAdapter to display multiple sections with synchronized tab and page navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing a tabbed ViewPager interface with fragments.

classes.name: SectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: FragmentPagerAdapter providing fragments for each section of the ViewPager.

classes.name: DummySectionFragment
classes.description: A placeholder fragment displaying section number, used as a template for actual content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ActionBar with tabs, and configures the ViewPager with its adapter.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Synchronizes ViewPager page with selected tab.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a fragment for the specified position in the ViewPager.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for each page/tab based on position.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view for DummySectionFragment, displaying section number.
